elements.requirement: If an offence is a scheduled offence as defined in section 22(1), the court proceeds in relation to the offence under section 17A(6) or 17B(2)(c), and the court convicts the accused, the court must consider whether the value involved appears to exceed the relevant sum, taking into account any representations made by the accused or the prosecutor.
elements.quote: the court shall consider whether, having regard to any representations made by him or by the prosecutor, the value involved (as defined in section 22(10) below) appears to the court to exceed the relevant sum

elements.requirement: Subject to subsection (4), the court does not have the power to impose a sentence on the accused exceeding the limits in section 33(1)(a) if it appears clear that the value involved does not exceed the relevant sum, or if it appears for any reason not clear whether the value exceeds the relevant sum.
elements.quote: the court shall not have power to impose on the accused in respect of the offence a sentence in excess of the limits mentioned in section 33(1)(a) below

elements.requirement: Sections 14 and 18 of the Sentencing Code do not apply to the offence if it appears clear to the court that the value involved does not exceed the relevant sum, or if it appears for any reason not clear whether the value exceeds the relevant sum.
elements.quote: sections 14 and 18 of the Sentencing Code shall not apply as regards that offence.

elements.requirement: Subsections (9) to (12) of section 22 apply for the purposes of section 17D as they apply for section 22, reading the reference in section 22(9) to subsection (1) as a reference to section 17D(1).
elements.quote: Subsections (9) to (12) of section 22 below shall apply for the purposes of this section as they apply for the purposes of that section (reading the reference to subsection (1) in section 22(9) as a reference to subsection (1) of this section).

elements.requirement: The limitation under subsection (2)(a) restricting the court from sentencing beyond the section 33(1)(a) limits does not apply to an offence of aggravated vehicle-taking under section 12A of the Theft Act 1968.
elements.quote: Subsection (2)(a) above does not apply to an offence under section 12A of the Theft Act 1968 (aggravated vehicle-taking).
